search_text: published ZDI-22-1021 ZDI-CAN-16259 VMware ESXi TCP/IP Memory Corruption Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-07-28 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['VMware'] ['ESXi'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of VMware ESXi. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TCP/IP kernel module. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a memory corruption condition. title: VMware ESXi TCP/IP Memory Corruption Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of VMware ESXi. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TCP/IP kernel module. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a memory corruption condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel.
